rca_of_issue: Repro: Login QA -> You -> Edit Targets -> open 'How this is calculated · sources' sheet -> try tapping 'Got it'. In multiple runs, click failed with 'element is outside of the viewport'. Likely root cause is modal/footer positioning or scroll/animation timing conflict when opened from a scrolled parent. Mitigation: enforce footer pinned visibility and tappable hit-region independent of parent scroll position; consider waiting for final layout/animation completion before enabling close CTA.
